title: Support Engineer Tier 2
description:

Support Engineer, Tier 2

Reports To: Director of Customer Support
Location: Remote (US)
Travel: N/A
Tech Stack: G-Suite, Slack, Zoom, Salesforce, Zendesk, Jira, Confluence
ABOUT ADDIGY
Addigy is a fast-growing SaaS company empowering IT professionals to manage Apple devices at scale. Our platform enables organizations and Managed Service Providers (MSPs) to monitor, secure, and manage macOS, iOS, and iPadOS devices in real time through a single, intuitive interface. We are guided by three core values: Humble - outcomes over ego, every time; Hungry - relentless in our pursuit of progress; and Smart - we’re curious, we dig, we never stop learning.
THE OPPORTUNITY
The Tier 2 Support Engineer is the technical backbone of Addigy 's customer support organization, owning the resolution of complex, escalated issues across macOS, iPadOS, and iOS environments. You will be the resource customers and Tier 1 engineers turn to when a problem is hard, urgent, or has gone unresolved, and you will see it through to a real solution.
This role goes beyond ticket resolution. You will represent the Support team in cross-functional squad meetings, contribute to the knowledge base, mentor newer engineers, and help shape how support operates at Addigy . If you are energized by technical depth, customer impact, and continuous improvement, this is your seat.
WHY THIS ROLE IS EXCITING

• Real technical depth: You will troubleshoot complex Apple MDM, macOS, iOS, and iPadOS issues that require genuine expertise, not script-following.

• Voice of the customer: You will represent the Support team in squad meetings alongside Product and Engineering, directly influencing how customer-impacting issues get prioritized and resolved.

• Build something lasting: Through knowledge base contributions, process improvements, and mentoring, your work compounds beyond the tickets you close.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
Customer Support & Ticket Management

• Own a daily queue of 10-15 active support tickets, responding to customers in a timely manner and managing escalations from Tier 1 with urgency and care

• Handle escalated tickets from Tier 1, Premium Support tickets, and multi-ticket customer situations through to full resolution

• Troubleshoot complex issues across macOS, iPadOS, and iOS environments, proactively reaching out to customers via email, chat, or phone to understand and resolve the root cause

• Follow standard operating procedures to ensure all issues are properly logged, documented, and escalated when needed

Collaboration & Problem Solving

• Represent the Support team in squad meetings, reporting identified ticket trends and driving customer-impacting issues to resolution in collaboration with Product and Engineering

• Create and manage Problem Tickets to track bugs, defects, and major product enhancements, keeping the Support team informed on progress

• Think critically to research and identify solutions to software issues, drawing on internal documentation, external resources, and cross-functional partners

Knowledge & Enablement

• Contribute 3-5 knowledge base articles per month in your area of expertise, creating, updating, and publishing content that improves the experience for customers and teammates alike

• Assist with the onboarding and training of new Tier 1 and Tier 2 Support Engineers

• Complete all required certifications on time, including Addigy Certified Associate (ACA), Addigy Certified Expert (ACE), and relevant Apple certifications

• Continuously identify ways to improve processes, work smarter, and enhance the customer and employee experience

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
In the first 90 days, you will:

• Take full ownership of the Tier 2 escalation queue and establish a consistent daily triage routine

• Resolve an average of 50-60 support tickets per month with high customer satisfaction

• Begin contributing knowledge base articles and demonstrate growing command of the Addigy

description:
Video Annotator
Location: Fully Remote Schedule: Full-Time, Remote
Check out The Global Talent Co. ’s talent network:
About the Role
We are looking for detail-oriented Video Annotators to support a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) dataset project. In this role, you will watch short video clips of physical tasks/activities and produce event-level annotations by segmenting each video into meaningful steps and writing clear, precise natural-language instructions describing the action taking place in each segment.
Key Responsibilities

• Watch assigned videos in full before beginning annotation to understand the overall task and context.

• Segment each video into discrete, logical steps/events based on visible action boundaries.

• Write clear, concise, and grammatically correct step-by-step descriptions for each segment, accurately reflecting what is happening on screen.

• Ensure annotations are action-oriented, unambiguous, and consistent in tense, tone, and phrasing across the dataset.

• Assign accurate start and end timestamps for each segment.

• Follow annotation guidelines, taxonomies, and style guides provided by the project team.

• Flag videos that are unclear, corrupted, mislabeled, or otherwise unsuitable for annotation.

• Participate in calibration sessions and incorporate reviewer/QA feedback to improve annotation quality and consistency.

• Meet daily/weekly productivity and quality targets without compromising accuracy.

• Maintain confidentiality of all project data and materials.

Required Qualifications

• English Proficiency: C1 level (CEFR) or above - strong command of grammar, vocabulary, and sentence construction is essential.

• Excellent attention to detail and ability to spot subtle changes in visual scenes.

• Strong written communication skills; ability to describe actions concisely and precisely.

• Comfort working with video-based tools and annotation software (training provided).

• Ability to work independently, follow detailed guidelines, and maintain consistency over repetitive tasks.

• Reliable internet connection and access to a computer with a modern browser.

• Basic computer literacy (file handling, web-based tools, spreadsheets).

Preferred Qualifications

• Prior experience in data annotation, labeling, transcription, or content moderation.

• Familiarity with AI/ML concepts, especially computer vision, NLP, or robotics datasets.

• Experience writing instructional or procedural content (how-to guides, SOPs, recipes).

• Exposure to annotation platforms (e.g., CVAT, Label Studio, Scale, or similar tools).

title: Unity Technical Artist, Event Pipeline
description:
Help us ship new 3D immersive events and content to the VRChat community, reliably, efficiently, and with a high quality bar.

Join the VRChat team!

We’re building the future of immersive, user-generated worlds, where anyone, anywhere, can connect, play, explore, and express themselves.

We’re looking for a Unity Technical Artist to support VRChat ’s live ops events and content pipeline. This role sits at the intersection of art and engineering: you’ll be hands-on in Unity, you’ll write scripts/tools to make publishing more efficient, and you’ll help our events and content ship smoothly across platforms.

You’ll partner closely with artists, designers, and engineers, so creative work moves from “done” to “shipped” without surprises.

What You'll Do

• Own and evolve the end-to-end Unity content pipeline for live ops assets, helping us ship 3D props and content updates with consistency and speed.

• Implement and validate 3D assets in Unity: prefabs, materials, shaders, collisions, LODs, lighting setups, and import settings, with an eye toward performance and reliability.

• Build and maintain tools, scripts, and automation (primarily in C# and Udon) that reduce manual work, prevent common errors, and make publishing repeatable.

• Create lightweight quality gates for content: asset validation checks, naming/structure conventions, performance budgets, and “ready to ship” checklists.

• Debug content and pipeline issues across disciplines, working with engineers on technical constraints and with artists on asset readiness.

• Collaborate with Product Design and Creators partners to ensure content supports the intended user experience and meets our quality bar.

• Document workflows so the whole team can move faster as we scale content volume in 2026.

Who You Are

• You have 3+ years experience as a Technical Artist, Tools Artist, or similar role (or equivalent shipped work).

• You’re deeply comfortable in Unity and understand what it takes to ship real-time 3D content that performs well.

• You can write scripts (most likely C# ) and you’ve built tools or automation that helped teams move faster or reduced production risk.

• You understand 3D fundamentals (meshes, materials, textures, lighting, optimization) and can collaborate effectively with artists on asset quality.

• You think in systems and pipelines: you notice recurring failure modes, then design guardrails that prevent them.

• You communicate clearly across disciplines and enjoy being the person who turns ambiguity into a reliable workflow.

• You have a strong ownership mindset: you care about shipping, not just “building a perfect tool someday.”

Bonus Points (Not required, but we’d be excited if you bring any of the following!)

• Experience building editor tooling, import automation, or asset validation pipelines in Unity.

• Familiarity with the VRChat creator toolchain: Unity + VRChat SDK (Worlds/Avatars) + Creator Companion (VCC/VPM)

• Experience building interactivity in VRChat worlds using Udon / UdonSharp (C# that compiles to Udon)

• Familiarity with common VRChat avatar components like PhysBones/Contacts and performance best practices.

• Experience optimizing content for multiple hardware tiers and platforms (PC + mobile constraints, etc.).

• Experience supporting live ops or high-cadence content publishing.

Not sure if you meet every single requirement?
We’d still love to hear from you. We know technical artists come from all kinds of backgrounds. If you’re excited to help ship a steady stream of 3D content to a global community, and you like making pipelines fast, safe, and human-friendly, please apply.

Where You’ll Be
This is a remote-first role. Work from wherever you do your best thinking. We’re a fully distributed company with team members across the globe. While we work asynchronously, overlap with U.S. time zones is needed for team collaboration.

Benefits

• 100% Remote - work from anywhere in the world

• Health benefits for U.S. and Can

title: Mobile Application Business Analyst (Employed or freelance)
description:
📋 Tâches et responsabilités
Vous rejoignez une équipe en charge de l’analyse, de la préparation et de l’exécution de projets digitaux. Dans le cadre de la refonte complète d’une application mobile, vous jouez un rôle clé dans la traduction des besoins métier en éléments fonctionnels clairs, cohérents et exploitables par les équipes UX/UI et de développement.
Vous intervenez sur l’ensemble du cycle de définition fonctionnelle jusqu’à la préparation du développement, avec une attention particulière portée à la cohérence entre parcours utilisateurs, écrans, backlog et critères d’acceptation.
Description de mission
Le rôle consiste à faire le lien entre :

• les besoins métier,

• l’expérience utilisateur (UX),

• les équipes design,

• les équipes de développement,

• l’architecture,

• la QA et la gestion de projet.

Vous êtes garant de la structuration des parcours utilisateurs, de la transformation des besoins en spécifications fonctionnelles et de la traçabilité entre les différentes étapes de conception et de delivery.
Responsabilités principales
1. Analyse métier et cadrage fonctionnel

• Recueillir les besoins métier et utilisateurs.

• Challenge les demandes afin d’en clarifier les objectifs réels.

• Structurer les User Journeys et formaliser les parcours détaillés.

• Identifier les pain points, les cas complexes et les dépendances.

• Prioriser les besoins avec les parties prenantes du projet.

2. Structuration des parcours utilisateurs

• Définir les parcours de bout en bout.

• Décomposer chaque parcours en étapes détaillées.

• Prendre en compte les variantes, exceptions, cas d’erreur, scénarios offline, dépendances temps réel et besoins d’accessibilité (PMR).

• Garantir une couverture complète des scénarios critiques et des edge cases.

3. Transformation des besoins en éléments exploitables
Vous structurez et maintenez la traçabilité complète entre :
User Journey → Features → Screens → User Stories → Acceptance Criteria

• Transformer les besoins métier en fonctionnalités détaillées.

• Réaliser le screen mapping et contribuer au screen inventory.

• Formaliser des wireflows fonctionnels clairs.

• Veiller à l’exhaustivité des écrans et à la cohérence des comportements attendus.

4. Préparation du travail UX/UI

• Préparer les éléments nécessaires au travail des designers.

• Définir le maillage des écrans et les comportements fonctionnels.

• Documenter les différents états : loading, error, empty, offline et edge cases.

• Collaborer étroitement avec les UX/UI Designers pour assurer la cohérence des parcours.

5. Gestion et structuration du backlog

• Rédiger les Epics et les User Stories.

• Définir des Acceptance Criteria précis et exploitables.

• Structurer les dépendances et préparer les refinements.

• Maintenir un backlog complexe clair, priorisé et actionnable dans un cadre Agile / Scrum.

6. Coordination avec les équipes de delivery

• Collaborer avec les équipes techniques afin de clarifier les comportements attendus.

• Participer aux ateliers UX/UI et aux refinements Agile.

• Apporter un support aux équipes QA/UAT.

• Faciliter l’alignement entre les besoins métier, la conception et l’implémentation.

7. Documentation et gouvernance fonctionnelle

• Maintenir la documentation fonctionnelle dans Confluence.

• Utiliser des outils de modélisation tels que Draw.io lorsque pertinent.

• Structurer les référentiels fonctionnels avec rigueur.

• Garantir la cohérence documentaire et la traçabilité entre besoins, parcours, écrans, stories et tests.

• Assurer une rédaction fonctionnelle de haut niveau, adaptée à des projets mobiles complexes.

Livrables attendus

• User Journeys détaillés

• Mapping fonctionnel

• Screen Inventory

• Wireflows fonctionnels

• Epics

• User Stories

• Acceptance Criteria

• Documentation Confluence

• Support aux scénarios UAT

• Matrices de traçabilité

title: Account Manager
description:
ABOUT US:

AI NEEDS A NEW INFRASTRUCTURE LAYER. WE'RE BUILDING IT AT MODAL.

Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now.

Our customers include category-defining companies like Lovable https://modal.com/blog/lovable-case-study, Ramp https://modal.com/blog/how-ramp-built-a-full-context-background-coding-agent-on-modal, Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low-latency inference, fine-tune models, and access production-ready sandboxes at scale.

We recently raised a $355M Series C https://modal.com/blog/modal-series-c at a $4.65B valuation, led by General Catalyst and Redpoint Ventures. We've crossed $300M+ ARR and grown fivefold since September.

Our team includes creators of popular open-source projects (e.g., Seaborn https://github.com/mwaskom/seaborn, Luigi https://github.com/spotify/luigi), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring the first Account Managers at Modal. You'll report to the Regional Director of Account Management and be a founding member of the team.

This function does not exist yet. There is no playbook, no territory map, no established motion. You'll own a book of business from day one and build the motion at the same time - from fast-moving AI startups to large enterprise teams running critical infrastructure on Modal.

This is a commercial role with a revenue target. You'll be measured on retention and expansion across your accounts. While you won't be delivering the technical recommendations and implementation, the work is technical by nature. Our customers are engineers running GPU workloads, inference, and batch jobs in production, and you need to hold your own in those conversations.

The profile we're hiring is a technical account manager. You've worked at companies that are deeply technical and consumption in nature. You bring the commercial instincts to grow revenue from an existing base and enough technical depth to know which conversation actually matters. And you can credibly work with a CxO all the way down to a Developer.

WHAT THE ROLE IS

- A founding seat. You're helping build the AM function with us, not joining one that already runs. The account plans, expansion motions, and customer cadence you and the rest of the founding team figure out are what we scale to every AM we hire after you.

- A technical customer-facing role. You'll work directly with Developers and ML teams on what they're building and how Modal fits. You translate and triage the deeper technical work to FDEs and Product when it's needed.

- A book of business. You’ll own a set of accounts and be responsible for the revenue that comes from them. Expect to be meeting with customers in your first few days because the best playbooks are built from real experiences.

WHAT THE ROLE IS NOT

- A traditional post-sales role. You're measured on revenue, not health scores.

- An on-call support function. You're not fixing bugs or triaging tickets. You're driving growth.

- A technical delivery role. You're not implementing for the customer. You know where the technical work goes and you pull in the right people.

- An inherited motion. Nothing is handed to you. If you identify gaps in process, tooling, or a playbook - you help build it.

- A single-lane job. Our priorities go customer → company → team → me. We focus on delivering maximum impact vs. "this is my job".

WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

- Build Modal's account management function and iterate on it as we scale the business

- Own and deliver on a revenue target across your book of accounts

title: Security Systems Technical Lead
description:
Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced Security Systems Technical Lead to be embedded on our client’s Security Technology team.

The Technical Lead will provide expertise and direction for the design, deployment, optimization, and ongoing health of enterprise physical security technology. This role supports complex security systems initiatives, evaluates and improves existing technologies and processes, and serves as a key technical partner to security, IT, engineering, and vendor teams. The Technical Lead will oversee solutions from requirements and design through implementation and operational support, while identifying opportunities to improve system reliability, scalability, lifecycle management, and overall security program effectiveness.

This is a full-time, fully remote position offering a comprehensive benefits package.

Responsibilities

• Lead the planning, technical execution, and delivery of enterprise physical security technology projects, including PACS, VMS, video analytics, and related security infrastructure.

• Own projects from requirements gathering and technical design through testing, deployment, commissioning, and operational handoff.

• Develop project plans, schedules, milestones, and technical requirements while managing dependencies, risks, and resource needs.

• Evaluate existing security systems and develop remediation strategies to improve system health, reliability, performance, and operational effectiveness.

• Provide technical leadership for system migrations, upgrades, integrations, and lifecycle initiatives across on-premises, hybrid, and SaaS environments.

• Perform or oversee system configuration, provisioning, integration testing, troubleshooting, and issue resolution across enterprise security platforms.

• Review technical designs, system architectures, device configurations, and infrastructure requirements to ensure solutions meet security, operational, and enterprise standards.

• Partner with security operations, IT, engineering, vendors, and other stakeholders to align technical solutions with business and operational requirements.

• Identify opportunities to improve security technology processes, system lifecycle management, and operational workflows through standardization and automation.

• Develop technical documentation, SOPs, implementation plans, and recommendations that support sustainable system operations and continuous improvement.

Required

• 10+ years of experience designing, implementing, supporting, or managing enterprise physical security systems and technologies.

• Strong technical expertise with Physical Access Control Systems (PACS), Video Management Systems (VMS), badging, and related technologies.

• Hands-on experience with enterprise platforms such as Lenel OnGuard, C•CURE 9000, Genetec Security Center, or comparable systems.

• Demonstrated experience with system migrations, integrations, upgrades, commissioning, and lifecycle management.

• Strong understanding of security system architecture, networking, databases, servers, and cloud/hybrid environments.

• Proven ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues, assess system health, identify root causes, and develop remediation strategies.

• Strong project coordination and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple technical initiatives, priorities, and dependencies.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across security, IT, engineering, vendors, and other stakeholders.

title: Langfuse - Senior Product Engineer
description:
WHY PRODUCT ENGINEERING AT LANGFUSE

Your work will have an outsized impact.

Everything you build is open source (MIT-licensed) and immediately visible. Langfuse has 21,900+ GitHub stars and our SDKs are downloaded 23M+ times per month. When you ship a new feature the community notices in GitHub issues, on X, and in our community channels.

Product engineers at Langfuse are the people who deliver new features end-to-end to our users. You own the product thinking from understanding the user problem to deciding what to build to shipping the solution.

You will also have direct exposure to how cutting-edge LLM applications are built. The users you serve are some of the best and most ambitious software engineers leveraging Langfuse to improve their applications. Deeply understanding the problems they solve will help you design the best possible product and along the way makes you an expert on LLM engineering yourself.

 

YOU WILL GROW AT LANGFUSE BY

- Own features end-to-end: from talking to users, to writing the spec, to shipping the code and docs, to writing the changelog post https://langfuse.com/changelog with your name on it. To give you a sense: recent features a single engineer owned include the Langfuse for Agents https://langfuse.com/changelog/2025-11-05-langfuse-for-agents release (new trace views, agent graphs, semantic span labels), the TypeScript SDK v4 https://langfuse.com/changelog/2025-08-28-typescript-sdk-v4-ga rewrite on OpenTelemetry, and the hosted MCP server https://langfuse.com/changelog/2025-11-20-hosted-mcp-server for prompt management.

- Work across the full stack: and we mean full. Our surface area is wide: React frontend, Next.js backend, ClickHouse analytics, Python and TypeScript SDKs, public docs, Terraform modules, and more. You'll touch whatever the feature needs. One week you might be writing a new ClickHouse query for cost analytics, the next you're designing an SDK API, the next you're building a new React view for agent traces.

- Talk to users constantly: jump on calls, respond in community channels, and route support requests. At Langfuse, support is how we build conviction about what to build next. Our handbook says it best: support by engineers is a core value proposition.

- Write public documentation about the features you own. At Langfuse, docs are product.

- Ship publicly during Launch Weeks: we've run four Launch Weeks https://langfuse.com/blog/2025-10-29-launch-week-4 so far, dropping a new feature every day for a week. Engineers present the features they built to the community.

 

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- Someone who has built features or even entire products from scratch end-to-end

- Experience building and shipping user-facing products end-to-end, ideally in TypeScript/React and with exposure to data-intensive backends

- Someone who can manage projects themselves. You know how to develop strong conviction about what to build and how to ship it.

- Taste for great developer experience: you care about API design, UI details, and clear documentation

- Interest in open source software and genuine excitement about talking to developers about their problems

- Thrives in a small, accountable team where your output is visible and matters

- CS or quantitative degree preferred

Bonus points:

- Experience with ClickHouse, analytics databases, or building complex data visualizations

- Former founder or early startup experience

- Contributions to popular open source projects

- ML/AI background or familiarity with the LLM framework ecosystem

No candidate checks all boxes. If you feel you are a good fit for this role, please go ahead and apply.

 

PERKS

- Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

- Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

- Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

We are a modern marketing collective built for scale, efficiency, and impact. As the parent company, Agital supports three specialized agencies: Go Fish Digital , REQ, and WDG, with shared infrastructure, advanced technology, and deeply experienced people, allowing each brand to do its best work.

Go Fish Digital is an engineering-forward performance marketing agency specializing in SEO, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), its Barracuda AI platform, social commerce, and conversion-focused creative.

Go Fish Digital is where digital marketing meets clarity, creativity, and scale. As our agency grows and our client engagements become increasingly complex and cross-functional, strong project management is essential to ensuring great strategy turns into great execution.

The Project Manager serves as the operational backbone of assigned client work. Senior Backend Engineer- Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Senior Backend Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000-$112,000 Annually
Experience Required: 7+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking a Senior Backend Engineer with deep expertise in distributed systems to design, build, and operate large-scale, high-throughput backend services that power mission-critical workloads. In this role you will architect the core platforms that other engineering teams build on, focusing on scalability, reliability, performance, and clean engineering practices. The ideal candidate will combine strong fundamentals in computer science with practical, battle-tested experience operating distributed systems at scale, and will be comfortable navigating the trade-offs between consistency, availability, and latency.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related discipline.

• Six or more years of professional backend engineering experience, with significant time on distributed systems.

• Strong programming skills in Java, Go, Scala, or similar.

• Deep understanding of distributed systems concepts, including consensus, replication, and CAP trade-offs.

• Hands-on experience with high-throughput message systems such as Kafka.

• Experience operating systems at scale, including capacity planning and performance tuning.

• Strong SQL skills and experience with both relational and NoSQL data stores.

• Hands-on experience with major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

• Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills.

• Excellent communication, documentation, and mentorship skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience leading complex technical initiatives across multiple teams.

• Hands-on experience with Kubernetes-based platforms in production.

• Exposure to service-mesh technologies (Istio, Linkerd).

• Familiarity with chaos engineering practices and tools.

• Open-source contributions to relevant distributed systems projects.

How to Apply
Would you like to know more about this opportunity? For immediate consideration, please send your resume to . Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at www.bvteck.com.
Bright Vision Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: AWS DevOps Engineer (Associate)
description:
Mactores is the agent-native AWS modernization firm. Most modernization work doesn't ship, it stalls in pilots, slips a year, or lands at three times the budget. We exist to ship it: production systems running, legacy retired, outcomes measured. Our delivery is built on Aedeon, the agent platform built by Mactores ' founders' sister company, which absorbs the repetitive 60-70% of engagement work, discovery, dependency mapping, validation, test generation, that traditional consulting bills human hours against. Forward-deployed engineers own the rest: architecture, judgment, and cutover, on dates we commit to in the contract.
This role sits in our Application & Database Modernization pillar: moving legacy applications, databases, and infrastructure from on-premises to cloud-native AWS on committed dates. Customers come to us with dedicated hardware that costs more every year, deployments that depend on one person's memory, and enterprise workloads- Linux, Windows, big data that nobody wants to touch.
You'll join the DevOps team that lands these migrations. Aedeon handles the discovery and dependency-mapping grind; you build the automation, monitoring, and CI infrastructure that makes each cutover repeatable and safe. This is a client-facing engineering role: you'll set customer expectations, meet them, and see your infrastructure work carry production traffic.
What you will do?

• Deliver application migration projects from on-premises to AWS.

• Deliver database migration projects RDBMS, NoSQL, DW, Hadoop from on-premises to AWS.

• Automate operational and server provisioning workflows using AWS CFT on AWS.

• Share responsibility for deploying releases and running operations maintenance.

• Improve operations infrastructure: Jenkins clusters, Bitbucket, monitoring tools (Consul), and metrics tools such as Graphite and Grafana.

• Provide operational support for the rest of the engineering team.

• Help migrate our remaining dedicated hardware infrastructure to the cloud retire the legacy, don't babysit it.

• Establish and maintain operational best practices, and implement monitoring for automated system health checks.

• Build our CI pipeline, and train and guide the team in DevOps practices.

What do you have?

• 2+ years of experience using Terraform for IaaC.

• 2+ years of configuration management and engineering for large-scale customers, ideally supporting an Agile development process.

• 2+ years of Linux administration experience.

• Deep understanding of version control systems (git), including branching and merging strategies.

• Experience with cloud platforms (AWS/EC2/ECS/RDS/CloudFormation, CloudWatch, etc.) and cloud automation tools (Ansible, Chef).

• Experience with software build tools (Maven, Gradle) and continuous integration tools (Jenkins).

• Production support experience with Java-based applications - this one's a must.

• Experience with Linux environments and scripting languages: bash, Python, Groovy.

• Experience supporting Node.js in production is a plus.

• Knowledge of service discovery tools such as Consul is a plus.

• Comfort working late evening hours, which is when most patching occurs.

• A proactive eye for what can be made more reliable - and the follow-through to make it so.

You will be preferred if

• You are AWS DevOps Pro or AWS SA Pro Certified
How we work?
We run a forward-deployed model. Engineers embed with the customer's team, own outcomes from discovery through production, and carry the delivery commitment personally. Aedeon absorbs scale; engineers absorb judgment; the contract absorbs risk. As an associate, that structure works in your favor: the repetitive discovery work is largely absorbed by agents, so your hours go to automation, infrastructure, and learning cutover discipline from senior engineers. The culture is casual and steers clear of rigid corporate habits. We care about what ships.

Life at Mactores

We care about creating a culture that makes a real difference

title: Software Engineer (Mid-Level)
description:
​
Job Description - Software Engineer (Mid-Level)
Reports To - Engineering Manager
Summary
AxisCare is hiring a full-time, fully remote mid-level Software Engineer to join a team that's actively rethinking how software gets made.
Does this sound familiar? You're a skilled developer, and you can see where things are heading. The engineers who are just coders - the ones whose value came from being the person who could translate a spec into working code - are the ones AI is going to eat up first. You don't want that to be you. You want to get ahead of this by going deep on the things that still matter: system architecture, software design, and a real understanding of the problems you're solving. This is a senior-track position, and you'll find a team of senior and staff engineers deeply invested in your growth.
We're no longer building the car by hand, so to speak. We're building the factory that makes great cars, with humans in the loop where the human touch matters most. We want engineers who are genuinely energized by that shift and want to help figure out what it means in practice. (Read more about how we think AI is changing product development.)
You'll join an autonomous project team working on our market-leading home care SaaS, built on a PHP web stack with a React/TypeScript frontend. You'll ship real features for real agencies whose operations depend on our software.
There will always be a need for people who deeply understand our customers' most important problems, solve them with high-quality software, and run that software reliably in production. That's the work that endures, and that's the work we're hiring for.
No egos here. Just a handful of humble, talented, and conscientious builders who play well with others and work as a team to ship great things.
What This Role Actually Looks Like
You'll be building well-scoped features with oversight and mentorship from senior and staff engineers who are deep in this work. But a mid-level engineer is something very different in 2026 than it was two years ago. Concretely, we expect you to:

• Use AI as a core part of how you build. Not as a novelty or a copilot for autocomplete, but as a primary tool for prototyping, exploring, refactoring, writing tests, and shipping. We want to hear about the workflows you've developed, where agents work well for you, and just as importantly where they break down.

• Push the tools until they fail, then tell us about it. We're actively mapping the frontier. An engineer who tries something ambitious with AI, hits a wall, and writes up what they learned is more valuable to us than one who sticks to what's comfortable.

• Care about the problem, not just the code. Since writing code is no longer the scarce resource, understanding what we should build and why it matters to home care agencies matters more than ever. The engineers who thrive here get curious about customers and operations, not just tickets.

• Ship quality software that's easy to change. High-quality software is valuable now and easy to change later. Moving fast with AI only works if the work holds up.

• Manage your time to ship on time. Make meaningful progress on what matters and avoid getting lost in unimportant details. This is more important than ever when AI makes it easy to chase rabbit holes.

• Share what you're learning. This is a team sport, and the team only gets better if wins and lessons travel.

• Write well. Good writing matters here. Remote work demands it, clear writing is clear thinking, and clear thinking is how you get the biggest impact from AI.

What We're Looking For

• At least 2 years of professional experience on teams building web apps with the full PHP stack, including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript

• Experience building React apps in TypeScript

• Working knowledge of object-oriented programming and relational databases (MySQL or similar)

• Comfort with Git and collaborative development

• Demonstrated, substantive use of AI coding tools in real project

title: Executive Assistant
description:
WHO WE ARE:

Aurelius Systems is a VC backed defense tech startup building autonomous, edge deployed directed energy systems for counter-UAS. We build laser weapons to shoot down drones.

We're a small team of engineers, former US military operators, and subject matter experts scaling America's directed energy dominance. The first cost effective, reliable and robust laser weapon system.

Our namesake isn't an accident. Marcus Aurelius wrote about doing the work in front of you, every day, without excuses. Henry Ford didn't wait for permission to reinvent manufacturing. That's how we operate, small team, unreasonable output, no hiding behind the unachievable.

In addition to our San Francisco lab, we've opened a Detroit manufacturing hub and we field test weekly on our own 400-acre private range.

THE ROLE AND IMPACT:

Aurelius Systems is hiring an Executive Assistant to work directly alongside our founders and leadership team, owning the systems and coordination that make the company move faster.

You’ll bring structure to ambiguity, close loops quickly, and become the person people trust to just handle it.

This is not a pure Executive Assistant role. It includes scheduling and travel, but goes beyond calendaring into internal systems, documentation, vendor coordination, office operations, and high-priority cross-functional work that does not sit neatly with any one team.

Where our Operations Specialist owns the hardware floor and physical operations, this role owns the software, systems, and operating rhythm of the company. Early on, the two roles will cover for each other. Over the next 6-12 months, they will diverge as we scale.

What You'll Own:

- Executive and team scheduling, calendaring, and meeting coordination, including support for the CEO and CTO

- Travel booking, hotel coordination, and logistics for team travel, demos, offsites, and visits

- Special projects, follow-through, and high-priority operational work that needs a clear owner

What We're Looking For:

- 2-5 years of experience in executive operations, business operations, founder’s office, executive support, chief-of-staff-adjacent work, consulting, banking, or another high-output generalist role

- Exceptional organizational ability and comfort managing many threads at once

- Strong judgment and the ability to turn a vague problem into a clear plan

- Bias toward simple systems that work now, rather than overbuilt process or enterprise tooling

- Clear, direct communication and the ability to work cleanly across leadership, teammates, and vendors

- High trust, strong follow-through, and comfort handling sensitive information

- Comfort operating in a fast-moving startup where process is still being built

Where you probably come from: A founder's associate or BizOps seat at an early-stage startup, consulting or banking where you learned to structure problems fast, or a military admin or personnel role where you ran the unit's systems and kept everything tight.

We want to talk if: You're the person everyone already comes to when they need something solved, scheduled, or figured out. You see a broken process and fix it instead of filing a ticket. When a founder calls at 10pm because something urgent came up, you want to be the one who answers.

Not a fit if: You want a pure EA or calendar-only role, you're looking for hardware or facilities work (that's our Operations Specialist), you default to "what software should we buy" before "what can I build in an hour," or you wait for written process before you'll act.

title: Carpenter (Construction) - Memphis
description:
SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge.  Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. ABOUT THE ROLE:

The carpentry role acts as a key support system for all phases and disciplines of SpaceXAI data center construction. By building forms, platforms, railings, and related structures, SpaceXAI carpenters support the full construction team’s needs across civil, concrete, plumbing, electrical, and related disciplines.

As a Construction Carpenter, you will layout, cut, assemble, and turn over the temporary and permanent structures that keep the Memphis/Southaven supercomputer campus moving: concrete formwork, work platforms, stairs and railings, blocking, embeds, protection, and related wood and light-gauge work. This is a build job, not a facilities-maintenance job - you build what the next trade needs, then move with the work. This position is based in Southaven, MS / Memphis, TN.

This is an hourly position with overtime.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Build, set, and strip concrete formwork, bulkheads, blockouts, embeds, and related forming for foundations, pads, walls, piers, and equipment bases in support of civil and concrete work.

• Frame, hang, and finish wood and light-gauge structures, including blocking, backing, partitions, door and window bucks, and equipment pads per issued-for-construction drawings.

• Layout from control, measure, cut, and assemble lumber, plywood, engineered wood, and related materials to drawing, specification, and site standards.

• Build and maintain temporary facilities, weather protection, enclosures, and safety structures that keep other trades productive through all construction phases.

• Read and interpret construction drawings, details, elevations, and work orders; produce as-built markups.

• Follow fall protection, lockout/tagout (LOTO), PPE, hot-work, and permit requirements on an active construction site.

• Operate hand and power tools (saws, drills, nailers, lasers, levels); climb structures; stage, protect, and store materials.

• Coordinate with civil, concrete, plumbing, electrical, and other trades so forms, openings, embeds, and platforms land correctly for the next install.

• Support punch-list closeout and turnover with engineers, contractors, and vendors.

• Document work performed and as-built markups.

• Operate company vehicles and specialized equipment; inspect and store personal protective equipment (PPE).

• Perform similar or less skilled incidental duties as assigned.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• High school diploma or equivalency certificate.

• 3+ years of commercial, industrial, or heavy-civil carpentry experience building formwork, platforms, railings, framing, or related structures.

• Ability to read construction drawings, details, elevations, and work packages.

• Proficiency with construction hand and power tools and layout tools (tape, level, square, laser).

• Working knowledge of construction safety, fall protection, and PPE requirements.

• Ability to lift 50+ lbs, work at heights and in confined spaces, and work outdoors in all weather.

Join us and be part of something bigger - helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.
Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.
In this role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

• Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

• Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

• Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

• Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.
Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD
“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD
Per diem employees qualify for:

• Hourly base rate, plus additional incentive structure (i.e., per visit completed, other incentives may apply)

• Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

• Supplies and other perks

description:
About IONOS

At IONOS, we don't just manage servers - we shape the digital future for more than 6.2 million customers worldwide with our solutions. As Europe's leading hosting provider and a pioneer in independent cloud solutions, we are building next-generation infrastructure - from sovereign cloud architectures and high-performance GPU clusters to integrated AI automation tools.

Our tax team of six, led by our Head of Tax, covers the tax matters of all group companies worldwide. To support us in Berlin or Karlsruhe, we are looking for a Tax Specialist (f/m/d)  who wants to work across the full range of our tax topics and is keen to build expertise in transfer pricing.

In this role, you will own some of the most important pieces of our external reporting: the consolidated statement of cash flows, subsidiary and other compliance-related reporting, and the peer benchmarking that keeps our disclosures clear and comparable.

You will partner closely with Technical Accounting, Controllership, Tax, Legal, FP&A, Corporate Development, and our external auditors.

ROLE SUMMARY

We are seeking a sharp, execution-oriented Senior Finance Analyst in San Francisco, CA to own close, reporting, and modeling for our corporate finance function. This early role on the corporate finance team will play a pivotal role in building the FP&A foundation that supports a high-growth, consumption-based company.

This role will own the month-end close process, produce monthly and quarterly board reporting, run BvA and flux analysis for executive reviews, and play a key role in supporting our consolidated 3 statement modeling.

This is a high-visibility, high-ownership role for a finance professional who wants to operate at the center of a company’s financial story. You will work directly with finance leadership, Accounting, and cross-functional partners.

This role is ideal for a candidate who has 2-4 years of experience in investment banking, private equity / venture capital, public accounting, or corporate FP&A at a high-growth technology company. You should be expert-level in Excel and Google Sheets, comfortable building and maintaining complex financial models, and energized by the prospect of building something from the ground up.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Own the Monthly Close and Reporting Cadence

- Drive the monthly close process end-to-end, partnering closely with Accounting and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver timely, accurate, and decision-useful outputs

- Own monthly and quarterly reporting to the CFO and Board, translating financial results into clear narratives, key insights, and actionable takeaways.

- Lead variance analysis and management reporting, identifying the “why” behind results and helping drive performance discussions with the CFO and department leaders.

Maintain Our Financial Models and Reporting Infrastructure

- Support updates to the consolidated three-statement model, cash forecast, and long-range financial plan, ensuring leadership has a reliable view of runway, investment capacity, and growth trajectory.

- Partner with the People team to deliver accurate workforce reporting, headcount tracking, and hiring plan visibility.

- Support the implementation and ongoing administration of Pigment as our planning platform,  helping build the systems foundation for a public-company-ready finance function.

Operate Effectively in a High-Growth, Pre-IPO Environment

- Bring structure and rigor to a finance function that is being built from the ground up.

- Identify gaps in process, reporting, systems, or data integrity, and drive practical, high-ROI improvements that make the finance organization faster and more reliable.

- Operate with a high degree of ownership and judgment in an environment where historical data is imperfect and processes are still evolving.

- Own ad hoc analysis for the CFO, finance leadership, and cross-functional partners.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

Background & Experience

- 2-4 years of relevant experience, with experience in one or more of the following: investment banking, private equity or venture capital, public accounting (Big 4 preferred), or corporate FP&A / strategic finance at a high-growth technology company.

- Direct experience with month-end close, board reporting, and financial model maintenance is strongly preferred.

- Experience at a high-growth technology company and familiarity with consumption and SaaS metrics.

Technical & Analytical Skills

- Expert-level Excel and Google Sheets skills; able to independently maintain and extend complex, multi-layered financial models.

- Strong understanding of three-statement modeling fundamentals, BvA and flux analysis, and headcount and expense forecasting.

- Comfort working with imperfect data and translating it into structured assumptions and clearly documented outputs.

- Familiarity with Pigment or other planning and ERP systems is a plus.

Execution & Mindset

- High ownership mentality with a bias toward accountability, follow-through, and getting things done.

- Highly organized and process-orient

title: Public Relations Manager
description:
Overview
Seismic is hiring a Public Relations Manager to help tell our story as we enter our next chapter as the Go-to-Market Performance company. Following our recently completed merger with Highspot, we’re bringing together new ideas, expertise and opportunities, and we’re looking for a strong writer and curious communicator to help shape what comes next.
Reporting to the Director of Global Communications, you’ll join a team comprised of PR, social media and content professionals within our broader Brand, Communications & Experience team. In this individual contributor role, you’ll help strengthen Seismic ’s reputation through compelling corporate and product storytelling, PR agency partnerships, awards and more.
You’ll collaborate with Marketing colleagues across Creative, Customer & Product Marketing, Events, Web, and more, supporting communications priorities across the business. This is an opportunity to build on your PR experience, take on new projects and sharpen your communications skills as Seismic grows.
Who you are:

• 4-7 years of public relations or communications experience, with a track record of developing stories, managing projects and delivering results.

• Excellent writing and editing skills, with and without AI support. You can build a strong draft on your own, adapt to different executive voices and use AI thoughtfully while maintaining accuracy, originality and quality.

• Strong news judgment. You recognize what makes a story worth telling, connect business priorities to timely conversations, and know when an idea needs a sharper angle.

• Curiosity and enthusiasm for PR. A great earned media placement makes your day. A news story sends you digging deeper. You follow a range of outlets, voices and formats and bring fresh ideas to your work.

• The ability to think ahead and prioritize. You anticipate needs, weigh competing business priorities and keep projects moving as circumstances change.

• Strong relationship-building skills. You earn trust across teams, with agency partners and with key stakeholders by listening closely, following through and offering thoughtful counsel.

• Executive presence and sound judgment. You’re comfortable working with senior leaders, asking thoughtful questions and presenting clear recommendations.

• Initiative and ownership. You bring ideas forward, work independently and follow projects through to completion, knowing when to make a decision and when to seek input.

• Strong time management and attention to detail. You manage deadlines, coordinate reviews and deliver accurate, polished work across multiple projects.

Nice to Have

• PR agency experience, or a mix of agency and in-house experience.

• Experience in technology or B2B software. We welcome PR professionals from other industries who bring strong communications skills and a desire to learn.

• Experience managing agency partners, leading awards programs or turning research findings into compelling stories.

What you'll be doing:

• Manage our PR agency partnerships: Serve as the day-to-day contact for Seismic ’s agencies in North America and EMEA, setting priorities, reviewing deliverablesand keeping work aligned with business goals.

•
Develop compelling PR materials: Write and edit press releases, messaging docs, contributed articles, executive thought leadership, media briefing documents and other communications that bring Seismic ’s story to life.

•
Lead our awards strategy: Identify opportunities that showcase Seismic ’s business, products, people and customer successes. Manage the awards calendar and develop strong submissions in partnership with teams across the company and our PR agency teams.

•
Turn research into stories: Support Seismic ’s original and third-party research initiatives, partnering with Content, Web and our PR agencies to uncover newsworthy findings and extend their reach through earned, owned and shared channels.

•
Build proactive media opportunities: Follow news, industry trends

title: Coding Quality Specialist
description:
Position Purpose: The Coding Quality Coordinator II is the journey level position within a job series that performs complex reviews of clinical documentation on inpatient and outpatient medical records. Validates accuracy of diagnostic and procedural coding, payment methodology, and reimbursement amount; develops written rationale of findings; responds to providers for resolution of appeals.
Key Details: Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. Sponsorship and future sponsorship are not available for this opportunity, including employment-based visa types H-1B, L-1, O-1, H-1B1, F-1, J-1, OPT, or CPT.

• Performs complex review of physician clinical documentation on inpatient and outpatient medical records.

• Performs quality analysis to determine accuracy of diagnostic and procedural coding, the correct interpretation and application of official coding guidelines and rules, and assignment of appropriate codes.

• Determines correct payment methodology and reimbursement.

• Develops case-specific written rationale to substantiate and communicate findings to hospital, provider, medical director, and peer review team.

• Conducts coding re-review for decisions that are based on coding convention and sequencing guidelines, not requiring medical review.

• Identifies clinical questions and refers cases to Medical Director.

• Responds to providers for resolution of appeals.

• Reviews updates to Coding Clinics, coding newsletters, and other professional resources to maintain up-to-date knowledge.

• Participates in ongoing in-service programs for coding-related or clinical education.

• Identifies and interprets patterns of possible fraud or abuse and refers to appropriate party for further evaluation and corrective action.

• Conducts periodic peer reviews.

• Other duties as assigned.

• Performs other duties as assigned.

• Complies with all policies and standards.

Education/Experience: AA, Health Information Technology, preferred. Two years experience with Diagnosis Related Groups (DRG), ICD-9-CM/ ICD-10-CM/PCS, CPT, HCPCS coding.

License/Certification: One or more of the following certifications may be required: Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA), Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT), Certified Coding Specialist (CCS), Certified Coding Associate (CCA), or Certified Professional Coder (CPC)Pay Range: $56,200.00 - $101,000.00 per year
